name: Wat Tambor's Sheathipede-class transport shuttle
description: This Sheathipede-class transport shuttle was the personal shuttle of Techno Union Foreman Wat Tambor. During the Battle of Ryloth in 21 BBY, Tambor's T-series tactical droid TA-175 used the shuttle to leave the planet, leaving Tambor behind to become a Galactic Republic prisoner.
